title: Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins return to Bengals practice

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins return to Bengals practice
sources.description: The Bengals didn't show concern about wide receivers Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins missing Week 1 when they missed practice last week and the outlook continues to be good as they move closer to Week 1.
